meaning:
μισθωτός, -ή, όν
(μισθόω), [in LXX for שָׂכִיר, Exo.12:45, al. ;]
hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant, hireling: Mrk.1:20, Jhn.10:12-13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
